fusions.name: Churned Wake
fusions.desc: Kicks up a wake of water 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 water damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimmed Sheet
fusions.desc: Kicks a sheet of water that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets, throws it back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Paddling Underneath
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and you have 10% water resistance.
